import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Sample submission format to confirm structure
sample = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"

# Convert labels to one-hot encoded format for multi-label
label_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
y_train = train[label_cols].values.astype(int)
X_train_texts = train["comment_text"].values
X_test_texts = test["comment_text"].values

# Text vectorization
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2))
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_texts).toarray()
X_test = vectorizer.transform(X_test_texts).toarray()

# Train logistic regression for each label independently
model_list = [None] * len(label_cols)
for i, label_col in enumerate(label_cols):
    y_train_i = y_train[:, i]
    lr = LogisticRegression(multi_class="auto", solver="lbfgs")
    lr.fit(X_train, y_train_i)
    model_list[i] = lr

# Predict probabilities for all labels
y_pred_proba = np.zeros((len(test), 6))
for i, label_col in enumerate(label_cols):
    pred = model_list[i].predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    y_pred_proba[:, i] = pred

# Validate using a hold-out validation set from training data
val_indices = np.random.choice(len(train), size=int(0.2 * len(train)), replace=False)
X_val = vectorizer.transform(train.loc[val_indices, "comment_text"]).toarray()
y_val = y_train.iloc[val_indices].values.astype(int)

valid_aucs = []
for i in range(6):
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], y_pred_proba[val_indices, i])
    valid_aucs.append(auc)
print(f"Validation Mean ROC AUC: {np.mean(valid_aucs):.6f}")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission/", exist_ok=True)

# Write submission file
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test["id"],
        "toxic": y_pred_proba[:, 0],
        "severe_toxic": y_pred_proba[:, 1],
        "obscene": y_pred_proba[:, 2],
        "threat": y_pred_proba[:, 3],
        "insult": y_pred_proba[:, 4],
        "identity_hate": y_pred_proba[:, 5],
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

# Print final metrics based on validation
final_auc = np.mean(valid_aucs)
print(f"Final Validation Score (Column-wise ROC AUC): {final_auc:.6f}")
